preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in [n, b, q])
preconditions.description: n, b, and q are non-negative integers.
n is divisible by 5, and 5 ≤ n ≤ b ≤ 10^4, and 1 ≤ q ≤ 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(len(hint) == 2 and all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 0 for x in hint) for hint in hints)
preconditions.description: Each hint is a pair of non-negative integers (upToi, quantityi).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= hint[0] <= b and 0 <= hint[1] <= n for hint in hints)
preconditions.description: For each hint, 1 ≤ upToi ≤ b and 0 ≤ quantityi ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'fair' if (exists(set_S) and all(len(set_S) == n) and all(1 <= x <= b for x in set_S) and all(x != y for x in set_S for y in set_S) and all(sum(1 for x in set_S if x % 5 == r) == n // 5 for r in range(5)) and all(sum(1 for x in set_S if x <= upToi) == quantityi for upToi, quantityi in hints)) else stdout == 'unfair'
postconditions.description: The output is 'fair' if and only if there exists a set S of distinct positive integers between 1 and b (inclusive) with exactly n elements, where for each remainder r in {0, 1, 2, 3, 4}, exactly n//5 elements of S give remainder r when divided by 5, and for each hint (upToi, quantityi), exactly quantityi elements of S are ≤ upToi. Otherwise, the output is 'unfair'.
